rows.en:
Did you forget? I'm the one who built Fadita…

I put in an emergency shutdown routine ahead of time!

No matter how devoted a woman she is to you, she's only an organic droid in the end. Such a fragile thing… Ha ha ha!
[HERO4] is an organic droid!? She wasn't human?
[HERO4] is an organic droid!? She wasn't human?
[HERO4] is an organic droid!? She wasn't human?
[HERO4] is an organic droid!? She wasn't human?
[HERO4] is an organic droid!? She wasn't human?
I won't forgive you… I'll never forgive you!!
I won't forgive you… I'll never forgive you!!
What's wrong!? Lucifard? Is this the extent of the power of the man once called the Bringer of Ruin?

Ngh… Such power. Impressive…

But you know… no matter how you all struggle, Naager will achieve its goal!

Even so… we'll call off this fight for today! To celebrate our long-awaited reunion… I'll restore Fadita's functions!

…Reboot program activated!

[HERO2]!! What happened to me…?

…Reboot program activated!

[HERO2]!! What happened to me…?
But remember this… I will take you back with me, without fail!
Why are you fighting them? Naager is your own people, isn't it?

I just can't forgive Naager, infiltrating Earth's evil organizations and plotting to invade Earth without ever showing itself!

I see thwarting their schemes as the least I can do to atone for my sins…

Gavan… Until I defeat Naager, I can't let myself be caught.
Ngh… Damn… I let my guard down… ughh…
Defeat Atefarina the Battle Princess, the Kelbaan, and all of the Shocker army and the Phantom army!
<c3>Jiro</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Jiro</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
A secret base built deep in rugged mountains where no one ventures: the research facility of DARK, the organization created by Professor Gill, who schemes to rule the Earth with androids.
Dr. Komyoji, a genius of robotics, had been deceived by Professor Gill and forced to develop combat robots.
Dr. Komyoji… My apologies for disturbing your research.
Professor Gill… What on earth has happened?

There are signs that someone has infiltrated this secret base.

And what interests me greatly is that this intruder appears to be on par with, or even beyond, the androids we are building.

Oh? An android has infiltrated this base?

I'd very much like to see the real thing, and learn who on earth built it.

Finding it is only a matter of time!

When that happens, Doctor… I'd like you to have a look as well. Please excuse the intrusion.

I am Grey Rhinoking, the strongest of the DARK Destruction Squad!

My power has the energy of 100,000 horsepower! I'll smash your body to pieces!
Doctor!! I'm coming to save you now! Please wait for me!
Waaaaagh!
Those born in DARK can never leave DARK, ever! Come back to me… come back to me!

…!?

Professor Gill!
Why so surprised, Dr. Komyoji? Or perhaps this android looks familiar to you?
J-Jiro!?
Doctor!
Heh heh heh… So this was your doing after all, Dr. Komyoji…
Stop it! Jiro isn't even finished yet!
Doctor!!
Fight, fight, Jiro! To shatter DARK's schemes!
Doctor!
Gwah!
Komyoji's android broke through the secret base's wall and escaped!

Damn it…

DARK's secrets must be protected at all costs! After it! Chase it to the ends of the earth… and wipe it from the face of this world! DARK Destruction Squad!

Pride of DARK, power of the devil… After it! Chase it wherever it goes! Until the day we tear it limb from limb…
Doctor, are you all right?
Thank you, Jiro.
We'll be safe now that we've come this far! Mitsuko, please take care of the doctor…
Father, Father… Thank goodness! I knew Jiro would rescue you.

Yes…

Jiro isn't the first android equipped with a Conscience Circuit…

But Zero-One, which I built before DARK deceived me into working for them, still hasn't awakened from his slumber…

So, hoping this day would come, I secretly built one more, a new android for the sake of justice.

But I must hurry to complete him. DARK has discovered Jiro…
So this Jiro really wasn't built for DARK after all?

Doctor, Mitsuko…

I'll fight! I'll show you I can fight DARK's prized androids as an equal… no, better than that!

With this, the world's peace can be protected from DARK's evil clutches, right?

And Father, you won't have to worry about being forced to work for DARK anymore.

Yes…

With just one more connection wired into Jiro… he'll be perfect!

Doctor… DARK is going to launch a full-scale operation.

Please install the parts I'm missing right now!
That's right… We have to complete Jiro before DARK finds us…
Very well… Mitsuko, will you do the final touches on Jiro?
Yes, gladly…
Then go fetch the parts from the lab at home.
Yes, Father… I'll bring Masaru along too.
Mm… Be careful, Mitsuko.

Heh heh heh… Found you!

Komyoji, and the traitor android! None who know DARK's secrets will leave alive!
Doctor, leave this to me!
You insolent thing! Behold my destructive power!

Listen well, Komyoji's android!

You are a warrior of DARK! You must obey DARK's commands! Bring me Komyoji!
Waaaagh… Doctor… run… away! Ugh… aagh!
Jiro, pull yourself together! Jiro!!
That's it! Capture Komyoji and return to the DARK base!
Quit struggling! Komyoji! Resist and you'll lose your life!

Jiro!! The Conscience Circuit! Use the Conscience Circuit!

It's me! Don't you recognize me? Jiro! Don't let that flute beat you! Use the Conscience Circuit!
Ugh… waagh…

…!?

Oh no… Did the Conscience Circuit overheat? Jiro's functions have shut down!?

Well done! Now you're a fine warrior of DARK too!

We'll take Komyoji back to DARK as a test subject for the Devil Circuit…
Jiro!!
Professor Gill! We've captured Komyoji.

Well done…

Take him to the operating room at once and begin preparations for the Devil Circuit cyborg surgery!!

Grey Rhinoking! Return to the scene once more… and bring back Komyoji's android too! Now, go!!
Yes, sir…
[HERO4], did you really hear it?

Yes, it was the sound of a very powerful ultrasonic flute. It may throw off the readings of electronic instruments, which makes it very dangerous.

We should investigate the cause and, if necessary, eliminate it…

[HERO2], there's someone collapsed over there!

Hold it!!

There shouldn't be so much as a kitten anywhere around this secret base… Who are you?

…!?

Shocker?
